intent: When a bomb chain reaction finishes, a number popup showing how many bombs were in the chain rises above the player whose bomb started it, fading out over 3 seconds. Every player gets it, not just the local one.
accept: When a chain of bombs has finished exploding, the player who started it has a popup above them showing the chain's bomb count (a single bomb shows 1)
The popup floats upward, fades gradually over 3 seconds and then disappears
It appears for every player equally, including bots and other players, not only the local player
A test shows the chain count and event counter on the starting player's data increase after a chain of 3 bombs

criteria.text: When a chain of bombs has finished exploding, the player who started it has a popup above them showing the chain's bomb count (a single bomb shows 1)
criteria.evidence: after/shot-2 and shot-3: '1 chain' popups in player colours above bomb owners (before/shot-2 has none); rules.ts explodeBombs sets chain/chainSeq on rootOwner; assets.ts onSnapshot spawns the popup.

criteria.text: The popup floats upward, fades gradually over 3 seconds and then disappears
criteria.evidence: assets.ts: popup life=3, alpha = 1 - age/life, y rises age*28, removed when age > life; after/shot-3 shows older popups drawn fainter and higher.

criteria.text: It appears for every player equally, including bots and other players, not only the local player
criteria.evidence: after/shot-3: popups over many bots (lime and cyan) while spectating bot3; the trigger is not gated on 'mine'.

criteria.text: A test shows the chain count and event counter on the starting player's data increase after a chain of 3 bombs
criteria.evidence: rules.test.ts 'records the chain size and a rising chainSeq...' asserts chain==3 and chainSeq==1 for a 3-bomb chain, and chainSeq==2 after a second chain.

findings: Optional polish: with 12 bots the 3s '1 chain' popups pile up and overlap player names and each other (after/shot-3). In assets.ts consider showing the popup only for chains of 2 or more, or a shorter life or smaller size for other players, if the viewer spec allows. Not a blocker.
The ocr gate failure is unrelated to the popup. report.json says 'tesseract failed on after/shot-1.png: undefined', and shot-1 has no popups. It is a tool failure.
